mobbin:3c0845a8-624f-4a47-ad80-e57ab4bb1.summary: User moves from an empty day calendar into the Home dashboard, scans sales/appointment KPIs and activity, then scrolls to today's next appointments plus this-vs-last-month service and team tables.
steps: Day calendar empty — staff columns + 60% setup
Home — $0 sales KPI + empty upcoming + today's list
Home — sales $636 + upcoming 17 booked + cancelled activity
Sales chart tooltip on Tuesday point
Scrolled — activity + today's next + top services/team
Top services / top team this month vs last month
steal: Today's next appointments list with time, BOOKED/STARTED status, client, duration, staff (steps 1–5) — dashboard agenda that hands off into Scheduling.
Recent sales card: big number + appointments count/value + dual trend line Last 7 days (steps 1–3) — few precise KPIs with period trend.
Empty upcoming card copy when schedule is empty (step 1) — honest empty, not fake charts.
Header Complete Setup progress (60%→100%) stays visible on Home (steps 0–5) — first-run without owning the whole page.
avoid: Today's rows show status only; no Start / Check-in / Open session control on the card (steps 1–5) — Essentials needs a direct jump into Recording or Debrief from the agenda item.
mobbin:3c0845a8-624f-4a47-ad80-e57ab4bb1.fit: Replaces weak tile-only home with a compact KPI + today's agenda strip that lives on the dashboard and clicks through into Scheduling (and later Recording/Debrief); Reports owns deeper analytics behind the sidebar chart icon.

mobbin:7df9c1e2-cfd5-4c9f-84eb-718683ff8.summary: From a first-run setup drawer over an empty day calendar, the user reaches a populated week view and opens a flagged No-show appointment popover.
steps: Empty day calendar + setup drawer (team, hours, try tasks)
Multi-staff day grid empty — current-time line + 60% setup
Week view — appointment blocks + current-time line
steal: Staff-as-columns day grid with red current-time line (steps 0–1) — maps to rooms-as-columns center overview on the dashboard / Scheduling.
Right-rail first-run checklist with Start / Try now per task over empty calendar (step 0).
Week blocks color/flag exceptions; No-show popover with client + service + duration (steps 2–3) — exception state without leaving the schedule.
avoid: Full week/day calendar as the default home (steps 0–3) — Baseline already has Center Overview + Calendar; dashboard should summarize today, not duplicate Scheduling's grid.
mobbin:7df9c1e2-cfd5-4c9f-84eb-718683ff8.fit: Steals multi-column 'now' overview and No-show exception for dashboard → Scheduling handoff; setup drawer pattern lives on the dashboard for first-run, not as a second calendar module.
